_comment: Skill lesson rows (category: skill) - the one part of the retired
caps_seed.json that is NOT derivable from the DBE ATP documents:
skills are term-independent, carry a stable skill_ref, and are chosen
editorially (see the Skills convention in lesson_pipeline.py).
Topic rows live in lessons/curriculum/CAPS/{subject}/syllabus/ and are
loaded directly by lesson_pipeline.py load_seed_entries(); this file is

entries.subject: Geography

entries.prior_knowledge: Student can read contour lines and convert between map units
